subject: hero-cardwright
label: The Card-wright — default castle hero

identity.description: Athletic middle-aged Black man, a card-wright artisan. Close-cropped black hair greying at the temples, short trimmed beard, warm dark brown skin. Wears a slate-grey canvas work apron with brass tool loops over a deep teal rolled-sleeve tunic, ink-stained forearms, dark work trousers, and a hard brass-cornered card case on his hip. An engraver's stylus tucked in the apron. Calm, capable, unhurried.
identity.avoid: no sword, no weapons, no shield, no brown leather adventurer gear, no armour, no wizard robe, no cape, no chosen-one insignia

bibleNotes: Human's identity is CHOICE — the chosen path must be readable in the sprite (Bible §Human recognitionChecklist: 'Can the chosen path be identified?').
The chosen path here is card-wright: an artisan of the forge. Tools, not weapons.
Bible §Human visualDNA.avoid explicitly bans 'generic adventurers, brown leather, swords as default, medieval-soldier shorthand'. The avoid string above enforces that.
Bible §Rank continuity: sex, age, body type and ancestry are locked. Athletic middle-aged Black man stays that in every future frame and every regeneration.

palette.note: Soft harmony: the courtyard is passed as a colour reference so the sprite shares the scene's warm honey/teal register, but force_colors stays off so the character keeps enough contrast to be findable on the paving.
